sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_workflow_price_entries (tenantId,workflowId,priceLabel,calculationType,amount,eligibility,displayOrder,isActive,createdByUserId,modifiedByUserId) SELECT :tenantId,:workflowId,COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(:priceLabel),''),'Standard price'),:calculationType,CASE WHEN :calculationType2 IN ('free','informational') THEN NULL ELSE :amount2 END,NULLIF(TRIM(:eligibility),''),COALESCE(:displayOrder,100),1,:userId,:modifiedUserId FROM tbl_workflows w WHERE w.id=:workflowCheck AND w.tenantId=:workflowTenant AND :calculationType3 IN ('fixed_amount','percentage_discount','fixed_discount','free','informational') AND (:calculationType4 IN ('free','informational') OR :amount IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_tenant_modules tm INNER JOIN tbl_modules m ON m.id=tm.moduleId AND m.moduleCode='COMMERCIAL_DETAILS' AND m.isActive=1 WHERE tm.tenantId=:moduleTenant AND (tm.status='ACTIVE' OR (tm.status='TRIAL' AND (tm.trialEndsDate IS NULL OR tm.trialEndsDate>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='commercial.manage' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:permissionUser AND utr.tenantId=:permissionTenant AND utr.isActive=1)
